Container.Name: mangapixer
Container.Overview: MangaPixer is a folder-native comic/manga server and Angular web reader. It organizes your manga and comics collection by folder structure, features a fast browser-based reader, user accounts, cover thumbnails, and collection-wide search — all running in a single container.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI (container port 8080).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: State (database, cache, scratch). Mounted from /mnt/user/appdata/MangaPixer on the host.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Read-only media library root. Add individual shares under /media/<name> by changing the host path (e.g., /mnt/user/Manga) here, or add more Paths. The library picker in the web UI starts at /media.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for appdata ownership. Set to your Unraid user's UID (check with ls -ln /mnt/user/appdata).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for appdata ownership. Set to your Unraid user's GID (check with ls -ln /mnt/user/appdata).

Config.Name: Data Root
Config.Description: Database and backups location (inside the /config appdata folder).

Config.Name: Cache Root
Config.Description: Thumbnail and page image cache (disposable, inside the /config appdata folder).

Config.Name: Scratch Root
Config.Description: Temporary work folders (disposable, inside the /config appdata folder).
